cohort: 151 pregnancies diagnosed with early preterm stage II IUGR at two public hospitals in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, out of a total of 49,338 deliveries between January 2019 and August 2022.
finding: Early preterm stage II IUGR was associated with significant perinatal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: All neonates were delivered by cesarean section.
